'''Refrax''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The planet contained an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]]-controlled [[Refrax spaceport|spaceport]] that served as a stop-over point for ships traveling through Mortex sector during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
